question: Should Crabbox support ad hoc forwarding for an already-resolved SSH lease, or require all forwarded ports to be declared through the pond/expose lifecycle?
rationale: Both approaches fit the architecture, but the permanent CLI shape and whether readiness covers only SSH or the remote service require explicit product intent.

options.title: Add single-lease forwarding
options.body: Introduce a narrow command for ad hoc loopback forwards while keeping `pond connect` as the grouped multi-lease workflow.

options.title: Standardize on pond
options.body: Require callers to declare pond membership and exposed ports before lease creation, then improve documentation for that workflow.

recommendation.title: Add single-lease forwarding
recommendation.body: Introduce a narrow command for ad hoc loopback forwards while keeping `pond connect` as the grouped multi-lease workflow.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history connects this person to the shared SSH-backed provider and connectivity surfaces affected by the decision.
